key_insight: Single-target sputtering produces high-quality epitaxial D0₁₉ Mn₃Ge(0001) thin films, the crystal phase needed for its sought-after topological and magnetic properties.
engineering_relevance: This growth route supports Mn₃Ge thin-film development for potential spintronic devices exploiting Berry curvature and anomalous Hall conductivity.
method: Sputter from a single Mn₅Ge target.
Grow on Al₂O₃(0001) with a Ru(0001) seed layer.
Evaluate magnetic behavior for consistency with non-collinear antiferromagnetic order.
evidence_signal: The films showed weak zero-field magnetisation of (0.0086 ± 0.0002) μB/Mn, no saturation at high magnetic fields, and a Néel temperature of (291 ± 2) K.
watch_item: The Néel temperature near room temperature makes thermal stability an important concern for device operation.
paper_title: Optimised growth of epitaxial D019 Mn3Ge(0001) thin films via single target sputtering
